scope: Selected first-child keyed u32 accessor writes the N19 discriminator, exact success preserves that value, exact missing-key marker computes a context-word default, and every other raw status selects error. N19 admission is selected option/default zero, not a universal context-header equality. Native caller/owner/PAC/peer, complete parser/cleanup and daemon-kext pairing remain unproved.

QG1.evidence: Report QG1 and OD1-OD10; actual keyed u32 option/F output interface, two caller-phase producers, complete raw-status success/miss/error partition, preserved explicit value versus context default, exact byte-memory join and selected N19 admission. Eighteen ranges/326 instructions;308 modeled PCs,325 instances,297 definitions;22 new and107 replayed UNSAT certificates,one abstract scope counterexample,six integrity controls. Header equality is limited to the fallback arm. Native caller/owner/PAC/context/peer identity,complete parser/cleanup,external delivery and daemon-kext pairing remain unproved.
